changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestlaboratory AS SELECT dtl.id, dtl.test_id, dtl.property, dtl.system, dtl.scale, dtl.reagents, dtl.method, dtl.timing, dtl.test_duration_time, dtl.time_unit, dtl.sample_container, dtl.sample_volume, dtl.sample_volume_unit, dtl.tube_color, dtl.test_description, dtl.sample_handling, dtl.turnaround_time, dtl.turnaround_time_unit, dtl.preparation_requirements, dtl.medical_indications, dtl.associated_risks, dtl.test_instructions, dtl.category, dtl.tube_type FROM public.diagnostic_test_laboratory dtl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestlaboratory TO report_user;
